description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the ConceptNumeric class in the openmrs core project, validating behaviors such as equality, reference management, saving, and reference range handling.

classes.name: ConceptNumericTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ConceptNumeric class, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for Spring context integration testing.

methods.name: equals_shouldNotReturnTrueIfObjIsConcept
methods.description: Tests that a ConceptNumeric object is not considered equal to a Concept object.

methods.name: equals_shouldNotBeTheSameReference
methods.description: Ensures different internal collections of Concept and ConceptNumeric objects are separate instances.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptAnswerReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Verifies that ConceptAnswer objects' concept reference points back to its parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptSetReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Checks that ConceptSet objects' concept set reference points back to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptNameReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Ensures ConceptName objects' concept reference points back to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptDescriptionReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Checks that ConceptDescription objects' concept reference points back to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptMapReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Verifies that ConceptMap objects' concept reference points back to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldSaveAConceptNumericWithAllowDecimalValue
methods.description: Tests saving a ConceptNumeric with and without decimal allowed, and verifies persisted values.

methods.name: shouldRemoveReferenceRangeFromConceptNumeric
methods.description: Validates removal of a reference range from a ConceptNumeric and persistence.

methods.name: shouldMaintainInsertionOrderOfReferenceRangesWithConstructor
methods.description: Ensures that reference ranges added via constructor are maintained in insertion order.
